description_en: Queries real-time traffic monitoring data for live streaming domain names
description_zh: 调用DescribeLiveDomainRealTimeTrafficData查询直播域名的实时流量监控数据
name: DescribeLiveDomainRealTimeTrafficData

parameters.help_en:
The streaming domain name.

To specify multiple domain names, separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
播流域名。

多个域名之间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

If you do not specify this parameter, data in the last hour is queried
parameters.help_zh: 起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 不写默认读取过去1小时数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The name of the carrier.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to obtain the carrier name
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名。

通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获得
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The name of the region.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to obtain the region name
parameters.help_zh:
区域英文名。

通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获得
parameters.name: location_name_en

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。需晚于起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval between data points. Unit: second
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔。单位：秒

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is in UTC

StartTime.description_en: The start of the time range. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is in UTC
